text.card: A star about 38 parsecs away, 80% of the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 0.8 solar radii and 0.79 solar masses (FLAME) and 4,731 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 63454
quotes.card: HD 63454, formally named Ceibo, is a star located in the southern circumpolar constellation Chamaeleon near the border with Mensa.
quotes.introduction: To see the star, one needs a small telescope because it has an apparent magnitude of 9.36, which is below the limit for naked eye visibility.
